name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关性的信号审计员
tagline_zh: 跑模型前先做一次诚实的 EDA：先看分布和重尾，再用 CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE…
tagline_en: An honest EDA before modeling: distributions and heavy tails first, then verdict-style mini-tests.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 它不给你一张漂亮的相关性热图就完事，而是先处理重尾、再对每个假设给出四选一的明确判决，并强制样本量门槛。
why_en: It doesn't hand you a pretty correlation heatmap; it handles heavy tails first, then forces a four-way verdict per claim and.
limit_zh: 只做审计与判决，不建模、不调参、不产出预测；样本量低于门槛的结论一律标为证据不足，重尾处理也只覆盖它内置的那几种方式。
limit_en: Audit and verdicts only — no modeling, tuning, or predictions. Below-floor samples are marked insufficient, and heavy-tail handling covers only its.
title_en: A signal auditor that checks distributions before.
